english.title: Money laundering - assist in the use of the proceeds
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowing or suspecting that **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)

(A)_[was engaged in]_
(B)_[had been engaged in]_
(C)_[had benefited from]_

criminal conduct, entered into or were otherwise concerned in an arrangement whereby the said **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)'s proceeds of criminal conduct were used

(D)_[to secure that funds were placed at **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)'s disposal]_
(E)_[for **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)'s benefit to acquire property, by way of investment]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 93A(1)(b) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowing/suspecting that a person was/had been engaged in or had benefit from criminal conduct
entered into/otherwise concerned in an arrangement whereby proceeds of criminal conduct
were used to secure that funds were placed at disposal/benefit to acquire property by way of investment

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.
(ii) See section 93a(7) for meaning of 'criminal conduct'.
(iii) TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS PERMIT THIS LEGISLATION TO BE USED FOR ANY OFFENCE WHICH STARTED BEFORE ITS REPEAL EVEN IF THE OFFENCE WAS NOT COMPLETE UNTIL AFTER THE 23rd FEBRUARY 2003 (Statutory instrument 2003/120)

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
